chunks: And ʿAlī, peace be upon him, said:

If the father embraces Islam, he draws the child into Islam. Then whoever among his children reaches maturity is invited to Islam; if he refuses, he is killed. And if the child embraces Islam, he does not draw his parents [into it], and there is no inheritance between them.

key_terms.أَسْلَمَ: embraced Islam or entered into Islam
key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: Islam as the religion to which one is called
key_terms.مِيرَاثٌ: inheritance or mutual succession in estate

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about a father's Islam affecting his child and inheritance between Muslim children and non-Muslim parents?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the effect of a father's Islam upon his child and the legal consequences when the child reaches maturity. It also states that a child's acceptance of Islam does not extend to the parents, and that inheritance does not apply between them in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3556 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"If the father embraces Islam, he leads his child to Islam. When the child reaches maturity, he is invited to accept Islam; if he refuses, he is to be killed.
However, if the child accepts Islam, they do not bring their parents into it, and there will be no inheritance between them."
